title: Reliable Data Foundations
summary: Explain the platform and transform changing input into a trustworthy, replayable analytical result.
outcomes: Trace workspace, storage, compute and governance responsibilities.
Transform typed records with SQL and PySpark and check grain and weighting.
Resolve duplicates, corrections, conflicts and failures without misleading reports.
startingAssumptions: Comfort reading SQL, tables and basic BI metrics.
No Python, cloud workspace or paid account is required; optional bridges support unfamiliar foundations.
Ten substantial core topics plus two optional bridges; this is a focused path within broader Databricks study.
